news.detail: The catch and yardage totals were season-best marks for Henry, who took the field for 49 of the Patriots' 76 offensive snaps (64.5 percent). With fellow tight end Eli Raridon (ankle) making an early exit from the contest and potentially at risk of missing the Patriots' Week 5 game against the Raider

profile: role: TE1 rotational — 13% of targets, 84% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
